baseline_before.method: priced on the Nemotron cell's measured prompt tokens and visible output tokens per call (reasoning tokens excluded), i.e. as if the old app made the same calls; per passed run as well as per 1,000 calls
baseline_before.why: OpenAI's recommended replacement for gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1 and gpt-4.1-mini (retiring 2027-01-14, announced 2026-10-14), the models the targets' tests name

sandbox_runs.limit: MMD_SANDBOX_MAX_RUNS=80 for every phase-B command (orchestrator decision 2026-10-24 11:15; default in code 40)
sandbox_runs.plan: instructor ladder <= 8, llm ladder <= 8, third repo prepare + controls + ladder <= 13, patch confirm 3, fallback cells, smoke 1-2

budgets.tokens_only: only model tokens count against the caps; the Sandboxes `cost` field is logged as a diagnostic (billing check 2026-10-24: Sandboxes are not charged)

not_claimed: baseline pass rate 1.0 is assumed (strictest), not measured by us
K runs of one cell run in one sandbox at the same time, often with temperature 0: they are not independent, so the Wilson interval is optimistic

covered = the test fails when the proxy answers with an empty message (must-differ control 1); tests that check only types or shapes pass any well-formed answer; a second control with well-formed wrong answers is run only where the manifest lists control-wrong
streaming tests get server-sent events re-synthesized by the proxy from a non-streaming upstream call
during the ladder the proxy normalizes requests per rung (logged per call); the patched app is confirmed separately without normalization
per-call $ is priced on Nemotron's token counts; the baseline uses the same counts (another tokenizer differs)

runs are set aside as infrastructure whenever the proxy logged 402/404/429/5xx/None at the site or at a site its flip tests reach, whatever their outcome, and re-run at most twice; each cell lists how many set-aside runs had passed and how many had failed (runs_with_retried_infra)
after a run the hash check catches changed or missing frozen files; new files in test directories are recorded but do not stop the ladder
publication: every cell is published, including red cells, infra cells, cells of an aborted ladder, smoke runs and the 'old model stays' outcome; every job and cell is also appended to evidence/census/<target>/ladder-log.jsonl, and each ladder run writes its own ladder-<run_id>.json (never overwritten)

brain.rule: Super for repos under ~200K tokens of source, Ultra above

rules.cell_passes: at least K valid runs and pass rate >= baseline - margin (with K=5: at least 4 of 5)
rules.confirm: the patched app is run through the proxy route 'passthrough' (the body exactly as the app built it, no normalization) with NEMOTRON_MOVE=1, K runs of the moved sites' flip tests, same rules

embedding_model.rule: served for /v1/embeddings only when a target needs it; the same on every rung

rules.fallback: after the climb, every chosen site below Ultra gets one measured cell on the next rung up with its own parameters; the helper falls back only to a fallback cell that passed, else it raises
rules.fix_rule: at most one fix per red cell, proposed by the brain and accepted only when the proxy's call log recorded a diagnosis that justifies it; the fixed cell counts only if its calls show the request change the fix declares, else it is published as 'fix not applied' and the site climbs

a run is an infrastructure error, not a: the job left no summary (sandbox run lost) or the summary has an error
the pytest run timed out (exit code 'timeout')
a flip test of the site is missing from the run's junit report

the run logged a proxy status 402, 404 (the rung's model not served), 429, 5xx or None at the site or at any site its flip tests reach (or without a run index), whatever the run's outcome; each cell counts such runs by the outcome they had (runs_with_retried_infra)
infra.persisting: the site's status becomes 'infra' at that rung and it does not climb
infra.retry_rule: re-run only the missing valid runs of the same rung and parameters; a cell already holding more failures than a passing cell may have is not re-run
infra.stop: a 401 or 403 anywhere stops the ladder (the key was refused), with everything so far saved

rules.nested_sites: an outer moved site wins: a moved call inside another moved call is not remapped (the proxy attributes such calls to the outer, innermost-AST site, which is what the ladder measures)
rules.run_passes: every flip test of the call site passed in that run (a skipped flip test is a failure)

smoke.purpose: wiring check of the phase-B job with K=5 parallel runs (run tags, key file, test uid, frozen hashes, infra accounting, timings) before the first decision run; published; not for decision
